errorCodes.meaning: The network does not list the community, so there is nothing to repudiate.
The network at `url` answers as a DID other than `network`.
The community is a member of the network; it leaves with vtc/networks/leave.
The network refused the repudiation. `details.message` carries its reason when it gave one.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

acknowledgement.description: The community's acknowledgement (VMC carrying the grant's digest).

grant.description: The network's membership grant (VMC), once the community acknowledged.

listing.description: The network's listing credential naming the community, as the community verified it.

name.description: The network's name, as its profile gives it.

repudiation.description: The community's repudiation (VSC) of the listing, or — on departure — of the grant.

state.description: `acknowledged`: the community is a member — it signed the acknowledgement of the network's grant. `repudiated`: the community rejected the network's listing of it. `departed`: the community left, by repudiating the grant.

url.description: Where the network's API is reached: the base its `/.well-known/vtn` profile is served under.

acceptance.description: The network's `groupRegistered` statement (VSC), bound to the registration's digest.

endpoint.description: Where the network delivers broadcasts for the group: the community's relay endpoint for it.

groupDid.description: The group's own DID, which the registration names as its subject.

groupId.description: The community's identifier for the group.

registration.description: The community's `servesRole` statement (VSC): the group serves `role` in the network.

role.description: A role the network defines, e.g. `admins`: lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `_`.

schema.description: Reject a network's listing of the community. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

network.description: The network's DID. For a request naming a `url`, the community refuses if the network found there answers as another DID.

reason.description: Kept in the community's audit trail. Not sent to the network.

url.description: The network's API base, as the network's administrators gave it.
